commit.message:
fix: Ensure that the experiment_api feature compiles

The command

```
cargo check --workspace --features experiment_api --all-targets
```

would fail, because some of the broker binaries require the tokio
dependencies and some require access to the internal API. Use of the
internal API is now enabled for these features, and experiment_api pulls
in the tokio dependency.

We also added a regression test to make sure the experiment_api feature
compiles on its own.
